report_name: York University Discloses Breach of Data from Online Forms

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The university's public-facing online form infrastructure was compromised through an unspecified vulnerability, leading to unauthorized data access. The report suggests hunting for signs of SQL injection as a potential vector.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exfiltrated personal data that had been collected and stored in the underlying databases connected to the university's online web forms between 2007 and 2026.

attack_patterns.name: Web Shell
attack_patterns.description: The report suggests hunting for web shells, such as 'shell.php', on web servers as a potential post-exploitation technique used by attackers.

attack_patterns.name: Windows Command Shell
attack_patterns.description: The report suggests monitoring for web server processes like w3wp.exe spawning cmd.exe as a sign of malicious execution.

attack_patterns.name: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: The report suggests monitoring for web server processes like w3wp.exe spawning powershell.exe as a sign of malicious execution.

identities.name: York University
identities.description: A university in Toronto, Canada, that suffered a data breach affecting its online form infrastructure, exposing personal data submitted between 2007 and October 2026.

indicators.name: Web Attack SQL Injection Probe
indicators.pattern:
title: Web Attack SQL Injection Probe
id: 2b8a1b9e-7c3d-4f8a-b9e1-5f6a7b8c9d0e
status: experimental
description: Detects classic SQL injection probe patterns in URL parameters or form fields, as suggested by hunting hints.
references:
  - https://www.cp24.com/local/toronto/2026/11/08/york-university-investigating-cybersecurity-incident-data-theft/
author: cyber.netsec.io
date: 2026-11-08
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - "' OR '1'='1"
      - "' or 1=1--"
      - " UNION SELECT"
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects common SQL injection patterns in web traffic, as suggested by the report's hunting hints.

indicators.name: Potential Web Shell Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Web Shell Creation on Web Server
id: 8c9d0e1f-2a3b-4c5d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of common web shell files in web-accessible directories, as suggested by hunting hints.
references:
  - https://www.cp24.com/local/toronto/2026/11/08/york-university-investigating-cybersecurity-incident-data-theft/
author: cyber.netsec.io
date: 2026-11-08
tags:
  - attack.t1505.003
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
      - /var/www/
      - /srv/www/
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - .php
      - .aspx
      - .asp
      - .jsp
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of potential web shell files in common web root directories, based on the report's hunting hints for 'shell.php'.

indicators.name: Suspicious Process Spawn from w3wp.exe
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Process Spawn from IIS Web Server
id: 5f6a7b8c-9d0e-4f8a-b9e1-7c3d4f8a1b9e
status: experimental
description: Detects the IIS web server process (w3wp.exe) spawning command-line interpreters, which can indicate web shell execution or post-exploitation activity.
references:
  - https://www.cp24.com/local/toronto/2026/11/08/york-university-investigating-cybersecurity-incident-data-theft/
author: cyber.netsec.io
date: 2026-11-08
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the IIS web server process (w3wp.exe) spawning a command shell or PowerShell, a hunting hint provided in the report.
